summary.text: Angela Mosley is a Democratic member of the Missouri Senate for District 13, part of St. Louis County, first elected in 2020 and serving as Minority Caucus Chair.
Her official Senate page says she took office on January 6, 2021, and sits on the Appropriations, Gubernatorial Appointments, and Insurance and Banking committees, among others.

paragraphs.text: Her Senate biography says Mosley was raised in the Walnut Park neighborhood of St. Louis, graduated from Central Visual and Performing Arts High School, and earned a Bachelor of Science degree from Grambling State University.
It describes her as the first Black person elected to represent the 13th District in the Missouri Senate.
The page says she is married to former State Representative Jay Mosley and is the mother of three, including State Representative Chanel Mosley.
